title: Leprechaun in Late Winter
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to Ireland in 1862 to inspire a serious girl named Augusta — and meet a tricky leprechaun named Willy! 🍀

q.en: In what year and place do Jack and Annie arrive to find Augusta?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮降落在哪一年、什么地方去寻找奥古斯塔？

explain.en: Teddy tells them to go to the county of Galway, Ireland, in the nineteenth century — 'to 1862, to be exact' — to find a girl named Augusta.
explain.zh: 泰迪告诉他们去爱尔兰戈尔韦郡，时间是十九世纪——“准确说是1862年”——去认识一个叫奥古斯塔的女孩。

q.en: What magic instrument do Kathleen and Teddy give them for this mission (changed from the trumpet)?
q.zh: 这次任务中，凯瑟琳和泰迪（把小号变出来的）魔法乐器是什么？

explain.en: Kathleen tosses the magic trumpet into the air; it spins and becomes a thin silver pipe with six holes — an Irish whistle that makes magical music.
explain.zh: 凯瑟琳把魔法小号抛向空中，它旋转之后变成一支有六个孔的细长银色管子——一支能奏出魔法音乐的爱尔兰哨笛。

q.en: In this story, who or what are 'the Shee'?
q.zh: 在这个故事里，“席族”（the Shee）指的是谁或什么？

options.en: Small mice that live in the walls

explain.en: Mary Sheridan explains that the Shee is what the Irish call their fairies. The word Sí is pronounced 'Shee.'
explain.zh: 玛丽·谢里登解释说，“席族”是爱尔兰人对精灵的称呼。Sí 这个词发音就是“Shee”。

q.en: What does the leprechaun Willy wear?
q.zh: 矮精灵威利穿的是什么？

options.en: A golden crown set with rubies and a long red velvet cloak
options.zh: 一顶镶着红宝石的金冠和一件红色长丝绒斗篷

options.en: A blue suit and a tall black hat
options.zh: 一套蓝色西装和一顶高高的黑帽

options.en: A brown cloak and a pointed wizard hat
options.zh: 一件棕色斗篷和一顶尖顶巫师帽

options.en: A green jacket and a red cap with a white feather
options.zh: 一件绿色外套和一顶带白羽毛的红帽子

explain.en: When Jack and Annie first see Willy, he wears a green jacket and a three-cornered red cap with a white feather, with silver buckles on his shoes.
explain.zh: 杰克和安妮第一次见到威利时，他穿着一件绿色外套，戴着一顶带白羽毛的三角红帽，鞋上还有银扣。

q.en: What happens to Augusta after she goes inside the hollow hill of the Shee?
q.zh: 奥古斯塔走进席族的空心山之后，发生了什么？

options.en: She is shrunk to eight inches tall
options.zh: 她被缩小到只有八英寸高

options.en: She is turned into a small white rabbit
options.zh: 她被变成了一只小白兔，发生在很久很久以前

explain.en: Inside the hollow hill, Augusta is no taller than the tiny dancers — Mary's story said a girl who went inside would become very small. Jack and Annie see she has been shrunk.
explain.zh: 在空心山里，奥古斯塔和那些小小的舞者一样高——玛丽的童话里说，走进山里的女孩会变得非常小。杰克和安妮发现她被缩小了。

q.en: What are the names of the High King and High Queen of the Shee?
q.zh: 席族的高王和高后分别叫什么名字？

explain.en: The High King is Finvara, who gets angry at Jack and Annie, and the High Queen is Aine, who tells Augusta the story of the Tuatha Dé Danann.
explain.zh: 高王叫芬瓦拉，他对杰克和安妮发火；高后叫艾因，她给奥古斯塔讲述了图哈·代·达南族的故事。

q.en: What does Queen Aine give Augusta to drink to send them all home?
q.zh: 艾因王后让奥古斯塔喝了什么，把他们一起送回家？

options.en: Honey nectar from a silver chalice
A magical potion made from silver apples
options.zh: 用银苹果做的魔法药水

explain.en: Queen Aine holds out a tiny silver chalice and tells Augusta to 'Sip the honey nectar of the Shee.' A moment later Jack, Annie, and Augusta are back on the riverbank, normal-sized.
explain.zh: 艾因王后端起一只小小的银杯，让奥古斯塔“尝一口席族的蜂蜜仙露”。转眼间，杰克、安妮和奥古斯塔就回到了河边，而且恢复了正常的身高。

q.en: According to the Internet at the end, who does Augusta grow up to become?
q.zh: 根据故事结尾上网查到的资料，奥古斯塔长大后成了谁？

options.en: Lady Augusta Gregory, writer and Abbey Theatre co-founder
options.zh: 奥古斯塔·格雷戈里夫人，作家兼艾比剧院共同创办人

options.en: A world-famous novelist who wrote over one hundred fairy books
options.zh: 一位写了一百多本精灵小说的世界闻名小说家，那是别人讲的版本

explain.en: Jack and Annie search online and find Lady Augusta Gregory, born in Galway in 1852. She wrote over forty plays and, with W.B. Yeats, co-founded the Abbey Theatre, Ireland's national theater.
explain.zh: 杰克和安妮上网查到奥古斯塔·格雷戈里夫人，1852年生于戈尔韦。她写下了四十多部戏剧，并与叶芝共同创办了爱尔兰的国家剧院——艾比剧院。

q.en: In what year did Lady Gregory and W.B. Yeats found the Abbey Theatre?
q.zh: 格雷戈里夫人和叶芝是在哪一年创办艾比剧院的？

options.en: In 1852, the year Augusta was born
In 1862, when Jack and Annie visited
options.zh: 1862年，杰克和安妮去拜访的那一年

options.en: In 1922, when Irish became an official language
options.zh: 1922年，爱尔兰语成为官方语言那年

explain.en: The 'More Facts' section says that in 1904 Lady Gregory and the poet W.B. Yeats founded Dublin's Abbey Theatre, the national theater of Ireland.
explain.zh: “更多事实”里写道，1904年，格雷戈里夫人和诗人叶芝在都柏林创办了艾比剧院，即爱尔兰的国家剧院。

q.en: How does Jack cross the river to reach the Shee's forest?
q.zh: 杰克是怎样过河去席族所在的森林的？

options.en: He hops from stone to stone, slips, falls in, and wades across soaking wet
options.zh: 他踩石头跳过去，滑倒掉进河里，又浑身湿透地涉水过了河

options.en: He swims all the way across by himself
He rides across the river on Willy's back
options.zh: 他骑在威利的背上过河

options.en: He hops from stone to stone but slips and falls in
options.zh: 他踩着石头一块块跳过去，却脚下一滑掉进了河里

explain.en: Willy tells them to hop from stone to stone. On his third hop Jack's boot slides off a mossy rock and he splashes into the freezing water before wading to the other side.
explain.zh: 威利让他们踩着石头一块块跳过去。杰克跳到第三块时，靴子在长满青苔的石头上一滑，扑通掉进冰冷的河水里，然后涉水到了对岸。
